header.title: Edit {{term}}: {{name}}
header.description: Update auth roles, allowed team roles, admin permissions, the admin payment option, seat cap, and validity. CPO swaps and removing linked courses aren't supported here.

validation.seatCapPositive: Seat cap must be a positive number
validation.validityPositive: Validity must be a positive number

linkedCourses.cannotRemoveLinked: Already linked PSes can't be removed here (would orphan enrolled learners).
linkedCourses.willBeLinkedOnSave_one: {{count}} course will be linked on Save.
linkedCourses.willBeLinkedOnSave_other: {{count}} courses will be linked on Save.
linkedCourses.noneAvailable: No other courses available to link.

permissions.heading: Admin permissions
permissions.description: Stamped on the {{term}} admin's FSPSSM rows. Empty falls back to FULL. Applies only to admins enrolled after this save.

paymentOption.heading: Admin payment option
paymentOption.cpoNotSupported: This {{term}} is backed by a CPO fee structure. Switching the admin payment option isn't supported here.
paymentOption.description: Which institute payment option the {{term}} admin pays via. Changing it affects future admin enrollments only — an admin who already paid keeps their plan.
